verdicts.evidence: The four cards end in green price lines ("From $89", "From $189", "From $24", "From $65") with no button or link on them; the only action is "Book a visit" at the top right of the nav.
Each card's price is shown only as "From $X" with no unit such as per visit, per load or per month.
The headline reads "Help around the house, on your schedule" and the Laundry pickup card says "We collect on Monday and bring it back folded on Wednesday."
